_comment: Audit worker configuration. Offline, deterministic, no LLM. Paths may use ~ and env vars. Each log source maps a workflow plane to a directory of Claude native *.jsonl transcripts. The Dark Factory and verify roots are populated by mounting/persisting their in-container logs there (see run-audit.sh and the packaging runner).
_context_limits_note: Saturation is only as accurate as these limits. Confirm them against the models you actually run; edit freely. Values below are reasonable defaults; claude-opus-4-8 is set to 1,000,000 because transcripts in this environment showed >390k-token turns.
_usage_budgets_note: Usage is computed from local logs; it is an OFFLINE ESTIMATE, not your real account/plan quota (the native logs do not contain plan limits). A budget is either a rolling window (window_hours) OR an anchored billing cycle (cycle:'monthly', reset_day). The rolling 5-hour + weekly windows mirror how Max plans actually meter; the monthly cycle is a self-imposed budget anchored to your billing renewal day (a billing renewal is NOT a usage reset). Set limit_tokens to enable warnings (0 = unset). metric: 'effective' (cost-weighted) or 'raw'. warn_at/alert_at are fractions of the limit.
